evidence.ACL: The contour of ACL is not all in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of grade 2 injury.
evidence.MCL: Increased infiltration surround medial collateral ligament, in favor of grade 1 injury.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: There are linear signal intensity in posterior horn of medial meniscus, it extends into the surface, in favor of tear.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus appears to be normal.
evidence.Contusion: Abnormal signal intensity is noted in posterior aspect of distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
